title: Review & Verification
summary: Validate a defined change boundary against its work item and the Code Review & Quality Bar, remediate in-scope blocker and major findings, and return PASS or FAIL. Accepts a Change Request, Bug Fix Spec, milestone, or Work Scope Brief; a direct run may create an as-built brief from named evidence plus an exact diff. Continue here when implemented work needs a delivery-verification gate. Launch with empty inputs to discover eligible work items.
